skill.name: house-plans

2. Call `search_house_plans`. Show 3 to 6 plans: name, facts (sq ft, bedrooms, baths, stories), the
3. For the plan the user picks, call `get_house_plan` with its slug and give the free download links
(other clients: add the remote MCP server URL https://mcp.ai-architectures.com/mcp).

content.user_title: Find House Plans by Size, Bedrooms, and Style
content.value_statement: Finding relevant house plans requires comparing room counts, floor areas, and styles. This skill searches the AI Architectures library and retrieves concept plan download links.
actual_capabilities: Translate requests into bedroom, bathroom, area, story, garage, and style search filters.
Convert square meters to square feet when forming area filters.
Present three to six matching plans with facts, floor plan images, and page links when results are available.
Retrieve a selected plan by slug and provide PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB download links returned by the connector.
Relax one filter at a time when no plans match and identify each change.
Offer a separate floor-plan-cad workflow when a custom drawing is needed.
limitations: Requires the external AI Architectures MCP connector; the skill does not include a local plan library.
Search results, images, file availability, and service access depend on the external provider.
Plans are concepts, not permit or construction documents; local codes and licensed professional review remain necessary.
Custom drawing requires the separate floor-plan-cad skill; this skill focuses on finding existing plans.

use_cases.title: Compare family home concepts
use_cases.description: Search by bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area, and stories to compare ready-made concepts before consulting a designer.

use_cases.title: Explore compact housing options
use_cases.description: Find ADU, tiny house, or cabin concepts using size limits and style keywords.

use_cases.title: Collect design references
use_cases.description: Review floor plan images and retrieve available CAD or model links for a selected concept.

prompt_templates.title: Find an initial shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three two-bedroom cabin concepts. Show their floor areas, bathroom counts, floor plan images, and page links.

prompt_templates.title: Search with specific filters
prompt_templates.prompt: Find single-story, three-bedroom ranch plans between 1,400 and 1,800 square feet, with two bathrooms and a garage.

prompt_templates.title: Handle limited matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for two-bedroom ADU concepts between 60 and 80 square meters. If none match, relax one filter at a time and explain each change.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: convert units and manage search tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve a selected plan
prompt_templates.prompt: For [selected plan slug], retrieve its details and available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB links. Identify missing formats and state the concept-plan limitation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: retrieve files after selecting a search result.

output_examples.input: What filters would you use for a two-bedroom, single-story ADU between 60 and 80 square meters?
output_examples.output: Search criteria: two bedrooms, one story, approximately 646 to 861 square feet, and ADU as the style keyword.

output_examples.input: Can I use a plan from this library directly for a building permit?
output_examples.output: These plans are concepts, not permit or construction documents. A licensed professional must review the design against local codes before construction.

output_examples.input: No plans match my requirements. What is the next step?
output_examples.output: Relax one search filter at a time and identify each change. If existing plans still do not fit, consider the separate floor-plan-cad skill.

best_practices: State required bedrooms, area range, stories, and style before searching.
Review and approve the third-party connector before sharing search requirements.
Have a licensed professional review any selected concept against local requirements before construction.
anti_patterns: Treating concept plans as permit-ready or construction-ready documents.
Assuming every search result has every advertised download format.
Relaxing several required filters without explaining the changes.

faq.question: Does this skill create custom house plans?
faq.answer: It searches existing plans. The instructions suggest the separate floor-plan-cad skill when a custom drawing is needed.

faq.question: What setup does it require?
faq.answer: It requires access to the AI Architectures remote MCP connector. Review the external service before adding it to your client.

faq.question: Which search criteria are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions cover bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area, stories, garage requirements, and style keywords.

faq.question: Which file formats can it link to?
faq.answer: It requests PDF plan sets, DXF files per level, IFC models, and GLB models for the selected plan. Availability depends on the provider.

faq.question: Are the plans free and available without an account?
faq.answer: The skill describes the library as free and requiring no account. Current availability and provider terms were not independently verified.

faq.question: Are these plans suitable for construction?
faq.answer: No. The skill identifies them as concepts, not permit or construction documents. Local codes and licensed professional review determine what can be built.
